items.summary: LWN.net Weekly Edition for August 13, 2026 released
items.detail: The edition covers various topics including BPF and binfmt_misc, CrossPoint ebook firmware, and new storage-code testing features. It also includes briefs on Django releases, GNOME shell, and QEMU 11.1.

items.title: Security updates for Wednesday
items.summary: Security updates issued for multiple platforms
items.detail: The security updates address various vulnerabilities in packages such as fence-agents, firefox, and kernel. The updates are available for different Linux distributions.

items.title: [$] Block-layer error injection
items.summary: Block-layer error injection interface added
items.detail: The new interface allows for configurable error injection, enabling targeted testing of storage code. It provides more control over error injection compared to existing methods.

items.title: QEMU 11.1 released
items.summary: QEMU 11.1 released with over 3,200 commits
items.detail: The new version of QEMU includes a long list of improvements and bug fixes. The release announcement and changelog provide more details on the updates.

items.title: An Extended Tutorial and Vocabulary for Relational Language Design in an Era of AI-Assisted Query Generation
items.summary: Tutorial on relational language design for AI-assisted query generation
items.detail: The tutorial extends an earlier SIGMOD'26 tutorial and covers topics such as recursive and path queries, nested relational data, and relational languages for problems beyond PTIME.

items.title: DexterSQL: Deep Schema Exploration and Rule-based Correction for Text-to-SQL Generation
items.summary: DexterSQL: Text-to-SQL system with deep schema exploration
items.detail: DexterSQL improves SQL generation with a deep schema explorator, database-agnostic rule creator, and other novel components. It addresses problems in prompting-based Text-to-SQL methods.

items.title: Enabling Differentiated QoS Degradation for Replicated Databases under Failures
items.summary: Differentiated QoS degradation for replicated databases under failures
items.detail: The study focuses on handling capacity loss in replicated databases after failures. It proposes a approach to define how the service continues while capacity remains reduced, with explicit control over QoS degradation.

items.title: Inferring Empirical Sound Resource Bounds via Symbolic Execution and Linear Programming (Extended Version)
items.summary: Inferring empirical sound resource bounds via symbolic execution
items.detail: The approach combines dynamic symbolic execution and mixed-integer linear programming to derive upper bounds for the worst-case resource consumption of functional programs.

items.title: New Orthogonal Multiwavelet Filters Derived by Matrix Spectral Factorization
items.summary: New orthogonal multiwavelet filters derived by matrix spectral factorization
items.detail: The new multiwavelets possess orthogonality, symmetry/antisymmetry, and provide better coding and smoothness. They are compared with other multiwavelets in subband-based edge detection and image compression.

items.title: Reverse Migration of Cloud Applications to On-premises
items.summary: Diel: Tool for reverse migration of cloud applications to on-premises
items.detail: Diel automates the reverse migration of cloud applications to on-premises environments using a combination of simulate, replicate, and delegate strategies.

items.title: embabel/embabel-agent
items.summary: Embabel: Agent framework for the JVM
items.detail: Embabel is a framework for building agents on the JVM, providing a foundation for developing custom agents.

items.title: omnigent-ai/omnigent
items.summary: Omnigent: Open-source AI agent framework and meta-harness
items.detail: Omnigent allows users to orchestrate multiple AI agents, enforce policies and sandboxing, and collaborate in real-time from any device.

items.title: tonhowtf/omniget
items.summary: Omniget downloads 1,800+ sites' content. Free open-source desktop app.
items.detail: It has a built-in course player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library. Omniget is powered by yt-dlp and keeps files on the user's computer.

items.title: AntigmaLabs/ante
items.summary: Ante is a self-contained agent harness. It works like Claude Code or Codex.
items.detail: Ante has a highly optimized core and does not have the dependencies or model constraints of similar tools. It can be used for various tasks without relying on external models.

items.title: LadybirdBrowser/ladybird
items.summary: Ladybird is a truly independent web browser. It is built with C++.
items.detail: Ladybird's independence could provide a unique browsing experience, free from the constraints of other browsers. Its C++ build could also offer performance benefits.

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2
items.summary: LTX-2 is an audio-video generative model. It has a Python inference package.
items.detail: The LTX-2 model can generate audio and video content. The provided Python package makes it easier to work with the model and integrate it into other projects.
